message:
As a grandparent, I find myself reflecting on the little moments when my grandkids ask the most curious questions about safety and what to do in unexpected situations. It’s a joy to see their eyes light up when I share stories and tips about being prepared. There's something comforting in knowing we can teach them practical skills that empower them for the future, turning those little worries into learning adventures. 

I came across a great resource that offers some helpful ideas on safety skills for families. It’s a wonderful way to engage with our little ones and help them feel more secure in their environment. Have you ever turned a safety lesson into a fun family game?
